test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a match, average of runs scored by 7 players is 63. If the runs scored by 6 players are 130, 42, 24, 53, 45 and 54, then how many runs did the 7th player scored?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate the net deviation from the average (63) for the 6 players:

⇒ (+67) + (−21) + (−39) + (−10) + (−18) + (−9) = −30

To maintain an overall average of 63, the 7th player must balance this by scoring +30 more than the average.

⇒ Runs of 7th player = 63 + 30 = 93

**∴ The correct answer is 93 runs.**
